warnings: Steel hip roof. Members from the sheet's หมายเหตุ legend: dashed = แป C-75x45x15x2.3 @1.00, solid = จันทัน C-100x50x20x3.2 @1.00, double-dot = ตะเข้ราง C-150x50x20x3.2, dash-dot = ตะเข้สัน 2C-150x50x20x3.2, long dash-short dash = อกไก่ 2C-150x50x20x3.2. Roofing หลังคามุงกระเบื้องลอนคู่สี (not structural, not recorded).

Two ridges: C3-C4 at +5.72 and C'4'-C'5'' at +6.01 (levels from A-07/A-08). The C' ridge ends are not dimensioned; they were measured by proportion and agree with the king posts on S-03 and the posts on A-07 — span_source scaled_from_grid, lower confidence.

Eaves: 1.00 overhang printed above A (A' -1.00) and right of 7 (7' 15.00). The left eave (x 1.00 = grid 2 - 1.00) and south eaves (y 7.00 for x 1-4, y 8.00 for x 4-15) are drawn but not dimensioned, so the diagonal hip/valley ends that sit on them are described in notes, not as grid refs; roof members carry the area ref A'-F x 1-7' (the lines that enclose the roof outline).

All members are unmarked: element_id null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). Hip/valley counts are counted from the drawn lines; rafter and purlin counts are not recorded (jack rafters of varying length / purlins drawn only in the cut-away).
The ridge, hip and valley members are printed with section sizes only — no rafter/truss marks; the king posts are on S-03 (ring-beam plan) and are recorded there.
